title: Review and/or analyze human-readable code to identify vulnerabilities
reason: The lint ratchet analyzes every tracked Python file of the engine with ruff's bandit (S) rules of forty vulnerability classes at zero findings, so a change that introduces one fails the gate (PW.7.2); the bandit rules left out are triaged in rules.lint_select with their reasons, and the secret scan reads the tree for credentials. The site's TypeScript is analyzed by its own lint (PW.5).
